theater: 上敘利亞幼發拉底河上游

battle.name: 第十五次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 上敘利亞幼發拉底河上游
battle.brief: 公元前一四三九年，圖特摩斯三世在位末年發動的第十五次敘利亞遠征，兵鋒再指幼發拉底河上游的北敘利亞，迫米坦尼一方的諸邦重納歲貢。埃及步兵早已改用直刃雙鋒短劍，埃及月牙劍此時主要是法老威權的典禮佩兵，常見於神廟浮雕與王家儀仗之中。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場遠征的交戰方，一方是第十八王朝的埃及帝國，另一方是以米坦尼王國為核心、聯同卡爾基米什、埃馬爾、圖尼普及上敘利亞諸邦組成的聯軍，邊境地帶的沙蘇人部眾亦常與之合流。埃及方面由法老圖特摩斯三世親任全軍最高統帥，野戰大軍按神名編為五個師團，即阿蒙師、賴師、塞特師、荷魯斯師與蒙圖師，各師團有自己的旗幟、軍官與徵召的民兵；法老身邊設維齊爾主管民政、糧秣與文書，另有「大隊長」與軍務監督率領先鋒與駐防將士。迦南與黎凡特一線由埃及任命的「居民長」管治，提魯關塞則是三角洲與前線之間的關鍵關塞，後方有尼羅河三角洲的船隊維持海運補給。對面的米坦尼是上美索不達米亞的胡里強權，首都瓦舒卡尼在幼發拉底河上游，其大王以附庸網控制北敘利亞：卡爾基米什扼守兩河之間的通道，埃馬爾在奧龍特斯河東岸，圖尼普在貝卡谷地南段，另有阿勒拉赫與哈馬圖等城邦名見於進貢名單。聯軍並無統一編制，步兵與弓手由各邦各自湊出，輕車數量有限；沙蘇人則以游騎劫掠與夜間突襲見長。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Egyptian Empire of the Eighteenth Dynasty and a coalition built around the Mitanni kingdom and joined by the city-states of northern Syria — Carchemish, Emar, Tunip and their neighbours — with bands of Shasu from the desert fringe often joining it. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh Thutmose III himself held supreme command, and the field army was organised into five divisions named after gods: the Division of Amun, of Re, of Seth, of Horus and of Montu, each with its own standard, its own officers and its own recruited levies. A vizier stood beside the king to handle civil administration, rations and paperwork, while a Great Chief of the Army and an Overseer of the Army led the vanguard and the garrison troops. Canaan and the Levant were governed by Egyptian Residents, and the fortress of Tjaru on the edge of Sinai was the hinge between the Delta and the forward line, with the fleet of the Delta maintaining the sea supply behind it. On the other side, Mitanni was the Hurrian great power of Upper Mesopotamia, its capital Washukanni lying on the upper Euphrates, and its Great King held northern Syria together through a web of vassals: Carchemish commanded the corridor between the two rivers, Emar stood on the east bank of the Orontes, Tunip lay in the southern Beqaa, and Alalakh and Hamath appear in the tribute lists as well. The coalition had no unified organisation; infantry and bowmen were raised city by city and the number of light chariots was small, while the Shasu were at their best in mounted raiding and night attacks.
people: 核心人物是法老圖特摩斯三世，即祭祀中的「真理之主」孟赫佩拉；他既是全軍最高統帥，也是每次遠征的部署者與停戰決策者，出兵季節、進軍次序、是否追擊與何時回師，都出自他本人的判斷。他的正妻麥特卡雷與王室女眷在部分遠征中隨軍，她本人於在位第三十五年去世。民政方面，先後擔任維齊爾的有阿赫摩斯、霍特普、傑胡提與那赫特，主持軍隊的穀物、口糧與文書；被授予「全軍將軍」頭銜的麥涅克佩爾塞涅布，是晚期軍務的實際主持者，與留下遠征次數記錄的將軍霍倫海布同出一代名將的傳統。留下自述者包括《孟菲斯石碑》所稱的「國王編年史抄寫員」，他奉命把法老在北方的戰功抄錄成篇，並曾被派往庫斯國界採金，說明遠征不只戰鬥，也有系統的記錄與戰利品清點。對面的米坦尼大王與卡爾基米什、圖尼普諸王公，多數只以城名留在史料中，這本身就說明這類戰爭的對手是城市與地方勢力，而不是留下個人傳記的君主。
peopleEn: The central figure is the pharaoh Thutmose III, Menkheperre, the One Who Is Established in Truth: at once the supreme commander of the army and the man who decided the deployment of every expedition, the order of march, whether to pursue and when to stand fast. His chief consort Maatkare accompanied the army on some of the campaigns and died in the thirty-fifth year of his reign. On the civil side the viziers Ahmose, Hotep, Djehuty and Nakht in turn handled the grain, the rations and the documents of the army; Menkheperraseneb, who was granted the title of Generalissimo, actually directed military affairs in the later years, belonging to the same tradition of soldier-officers as General Horemheb, whose tomb in Memphis records the campaigns. Among those who left an account of themselves is the Scribe of the Annals named on the Memphis stela, who was ordered to write down the king's deeds in the north and was also sent to the frontier of Kush to collect gold, which shows that an expedition was not only fighting but also systematic record-keeping and an accounting of booty. On the enemy side the Great King of Mitanni and the princes of Carchemish and Tunip survive mostly as city names alone, which is itself a clue: the opponents of this war were cities and local powers rather than monarchs with biographies of their own.
kits: 本卡的埃及月牙劍是一柄外彎的單刃兵器，砍下去不必回抽，在古王國早期曾是埃及步兵的標準配備，但到第十八王朝，它已退出野戰陣列。埃及步兵的近身兵器改為直刃雙鋒的短劍，即後世所稱的科普斯型，更利於直刺，也便於在密集隊形中揮動；月牙劍則轉為法老典禮上的佩兵，出現在加冕、賽德節與神廟祭典的行列裡，同時作為王權的符號，見於神廟「國王擊敵」的浮雕與王陵壁畫之中，並留在王家近衛與儀仗隊的裝備中，作為軍階與忠誠的標記。黎凡特青銅器時代晚期的墓葬與窖藏裡仍可見到同類彎刃單刃，說明這一形制並未從西亞消失，只是不再是士卒搏殺所用。與月牙劍同時在役的裝備很多：步兵以複合弓為主，配箭、長矛、彎斧與投擲棒，使用直徑約一米的圓盾，護身有青銅鱗甲，軍中亦有外來雇傭兵，例如舍爾登人與梅什韋什人。機動主力是輕型雙馬雙輪戰車，車輪僅六根輻條，車上通常是一名射手與一名駕手；攻城靠撞槌、斜坡與圍城工事；運輸靠牛拉的輜重車，飲水以運水車與沿途水井解決，海上支援由三角洲船隊沿地中海北上，在加薩與提魯一帶卸下穀物與水。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh in this card is a single-edged blade curved forward, so that a stroke does not have to be pulled back; it was standard Egyptian infantry equipment in the Old Kingdom, but by the Eighteenth Dynasty it had left the order of battle. The close-fighting weapon of the Egyptian infantry had become the straight, double-edged short sword, the type later called the kopis, better suited to the thrust and to the swing of a formed rank; the khopesh turned instead into the pharaoh's ceremonial weapon, carried in coronations, sed-festivals and temple ritual, and at the same time an emblem of kingship, seen in the temple scenes of the king smiting his enemies and in the royal tomb paintings, and it stayed in the equipment of the royal bodyguard and of the parade detachments as a badge of rank and loyalty. Curved single-edged blades of the same family can still be found in Late Bronze Age burials and hoards in the Levant, so the form had not vanished from western Asia — it had simply stopped being the weapon with which a soldier fought and died. Much else was in service alongside it: composite bows with arrows, spears, battle axes and throwing sticks for the infantry; round shields about a metre across; bronze scale corselets; and foreign mercenaries such as the Sherden and the Meshwesh. The main instrument of mobility was the light two-horse, two-wheeled chariot with six-spoked wheels, normally carrying an archer and a driver; siege work relied on battering rams, ramps and blockade works; transport was by ox-drawn wagons, water was carried in water wagons and drawn from wells along the line, and naval support came from the Delta fleet north along the Mediterranean to unload grain and water at Gaza and Tjaru.
tactics: 圖特摩斯三世的北方遠征有固定的路線與季節。隊伍在尼羅河氾濫之後的旱季出發，通常自三角洲或孟斐斯一線集結，走北西奈的沙漠商路經提魯關塞進入迦南，或沿海的維亞馬里斯路北上，並以海船把穀物與水運到加薩一帶的接應點，減少沙漠行軍的負擔；冬季的暴雨與泥濘使遠征必須在入冬前結束。行軍編制上，法老本人與王家近衛居中，先鋒由弓兵與偵察隊組成，負責搜索水源、探明敵情，也會襲擊水井與穀倉以迫敵求戰；主力步兵接近敵陣時展開成密集隊形，以箭雨與長矛牆維持陣線，戰車部隊集中在陣前，負責正面衝擊與追擊潰散之敵。經過美吉多一役的教訓，埃及人在會戰中多先以車兵與弓兵撕開缺口，再以步兵方陣與彎斧完成近身清剿。攻城則以圍城、封鎖與斜坡並行。遠征同時是一種外交施壓：維齊爾與各地官員向附庸諸王發出最後通牒，拒絕進貢者遭到軍事懲罰，服從者只需交出金銀、馬匹與穀物。戰後固定有兩項程序：劃定新的勢力界線並立碑，把當地王公之名刻上界碑；以及把戰果與進貢清單抄錄進卡爾納克的編年史。
tacticsEn: Thutmose III's northern expeditions followed a fixed route and a fixed season. The column set out in the dry season after the Nile flood, mustering usually in the Delta or at Memphis, and took either the desert road across northern Sinai past the fortress of Tjaru into Canaan, or the coastal road known as the Via Maris, with sea transports bringing grain and water forward to relay points around Gaza to lighten the burden of the desert march; the winter storms and mud meant that an expedition had to end before the rains. In the order of march the pharaoh and his bodyguard held the centre, while the vanguard was formed of bowmen and scouting parties whose task was to search for water, find out the enemy's movements and to strike at wells and granaries in order to force a decision; the main infantry closed into a dense formation when it came up to the enemy, holding the line with a shower of arrows and a wall of spears, while the chariots were concentrated in front to shock the enemy and to pursue the broken. Having learned the lesson of Megiddo, the Egyptians in a pitched battle generally tore the line open first with chariots and archers and then finished the killing with the infantry squares and the battle axes. Beside open battle there were sieges, blockades and ramps run in parallel. The expedition was at the same time a form of diplomatic pressure: the vizier and the provincial officials sent final ultimatums to the vassal princes, refusal of tribute was answered by military punishment, and submission cost only gold, silver, horses and grain. Two formal procedures closed a campaign. The first was the drawing of a new frontier, marked with stelae on which the names of the local princes were cut; the second was the copying of the results and of the tribute list into the annals at Karnak.
data: 關於數字，可確定的有幾項。第一是次數：卡爾納克的神廟名單列有十六次遠征，孟菲斯將軍霍倫海布墓中的自述又補上最後一次，合為十七次，本卡這一場是系列中的第十五次。第二是年代：它落在圖特摩斯三世在位第四十一年，約公元前一四三九年，屬於他統治的最後階段。第三是時間跨度：一次典型遠征自離開三角洲到返回埃及約三至四個月，正好嵌在旱季窗口之內。第四是參與者：後期遠征的進貢抄本上留下的城邦名目已不多，約在數個至十個之間，見於名單的有卡爾基米什、埃馬爾、圖尼普及阿勒拉赫等，貢賦包括白銀、黃金、馬匹、牛群、戰車、亞麻布、彩釉器與酒。第五是規模：史料沒有留下頭數，一般按新王國野戰編制推算，出征兵力在數千到一萬上下，車隊為數百輛。第六是距離：三角洲至提魯關塞的沙路已有數百公里，再北入奧龍特斯河谷至幼發拉底河又是一段長途，車隊與輜重隊在這樣的路上速度有限；月牙劍這類典禮兵器由專人攜帶，不佔運輸負荷。
dataEn: A few figures can be stated with confidence. The first is the number: the temple list at Karnak enumerates sixteen expeditions, and the autobiography of General Horemheb in his Memphite tomb adds one more, giving seventeen in all; the war in this card is the fifteenth of the series. The second is the date: it falls in the forty-first year of Thutmose III's reign, about 1439 BC, in the closing phase of his rule. The third is the length of time: a typical expedition lasted about three to four months from the departure of the Delta to the return to Egypt, fitting neatly into the window of the dry season. The fourth is the number of participants: the copies of the later tribute lists name few city-states, somewhere between several and ten — Carchemish, Emar, Tunip and Alalakh among them — and the tribute itself consisted of silver, gold, horses, cattle, chariots, linen, faience and wine. The fifth is scale: no source gives the headcount, and on the organisation of the New Kingdom field army an expeditionary force is put at anywhere from several thousands to about ten thousand, with a few hundred chariots. The sixth is distance: the desert road from the Delta to Tjaru already ran for several hundred kilometres, and the march on into the valley of the Orontes and the upper Euphrates added a long further stage, over which chariots and baggage wagons moved slowly; ceremonial weapons such as the khopesh were carried by appointed keepers and added nothing to the transport burden.
cause: 打這場仗的原因，是北方的權力格局在移動，埃及必須靠反覆的軍事展演來維持既有的附庸秩序。圖特摩斯三世即位時，米坦尼控制著上美索不達米亞與北敘利亞的大半，赫梯在西面安納托利亞擴張，卡爾基米什、圖尼普諸邦名義上臣服埃及，實則在兩強之間周旋；埃及在迦南與黎凡特的據點只靠居民長與關塞守軍維持，一旦北方盟友改變立場，沿海與內陸的通道便會斷開。因此每一場遠征都有年度性的理由：迫使諸王重複進貢、交換人質、確認界線，同時把主權的儀式重演一遍，讓地方看見法老的軍隊仍然能夠越過沙漠。第十五次的特殊之處在於它發生在系列後期，這時的遠征已從開疆拓土轉為維持秩序與收取貢賦的例行行動，但要執行的任務一點也不輕鬆：邊境諸邦屢有叛離，貝卡谷地與奧龍特斯河上游的城邦需要重新確認臣服，沙蘇人則趁亂向商道與牧場移動，截斷迦南與內陸之間的往來。王朝內部同樣需要這類遠征帶來的進貢、戰俘與物資，用以維持卡爾納克等地的營造工程與王室慶典的開支。
causeEn: The reason for this war was that the pattern of power in the north was on the move, and Egypt had to keep demonstrating military force in order to hold its existing order of vassalage together. When Thutmose III came to the throne, Mitanni controlled most of Upper Mesopotamia and northern Syria, the Hittites were expanding on the western side in Anatolia, and the city-states of Carchemish, Tunip and their neighbours, though nominally subject to Egypt, were manoeuvring between the two powers; Egypt's footholds in Canaan and the Levant rested on Residents and fortress garrisons alone, so the moment the northern allies changed sides the coastal and inland routes would be severed. Every expedition therefore had an annual logic to it: it forced the princes to repeat their tribute, to exchange hostages and to confirm the frontier, while the ritual of sovereignty was re-enacted so that the locals would see that the pharaoh's army could still cross the desert. What was special about the fifteenth was that it came late in the series, when the expeditions had already turned from conquest into routine work of keeping order and gathering tribute — but the task was no light one: the border states repeatedly slipped out of submission, the cities of the Beqaa and of the upper Orontes had to be brought back to acknowledging their lord, and the Shasu were pressing into the caravan roads and pastures in the disorder, cutting the traffic between Canaan and the interior. Inside the state, expeditions of this kind were still needed for the tribute, the captives and the goods they brought in, to pay for the building works at Karnak and elsewhere and for the expenses of the court's ceremonial.
impact: 這場遠征的後果，主要不在戰場上，而在制度與記憶裡。第十五次之後，埃及在北方的控制線沒有向北推得更遠，仍然止於北西奈的關塞線與地中海沿岸的據點，然而附庸體系被重新寫了一遍：卡爾基米什、埃馬爾、圖尼普一類的城邦名號在進貢抄本上重新出現，界碑上再刻一次王公的名，宗主權於是靠反覆的儀式維持，而不是靠常駐的軍隊。從王朝的長期走向看，這場戰爭屬於把北方政策收束的最後幾步之一：圖特摩斯三世晚年的注意力轉向努比亞、王室慶典與底比斯的營造，大規模遠征不再成例；他的接班人阿蒙霍特普二世仍要應付迦南的麻煩，而到了阿肯那頓時期，第十八王朝已失去對黎凡特的大部分控制。對北方強權而言，這類遠征同樣是一種信號：米坦尼與赫梯必須重新評估各自的聯盟，雙方在北部的角力在後來阿瑪納時期的來往信件中仍看得到影子，而赫梯文獻後來把埃及視為主要敵手，也正是在這樣的北敘利亞戰線上。
impactEn: The consequences of this expedition lay less on the battlefield than in the institutions and in the memory. After the fifteenth, Egypt's line of control in the north did not move further north; it remained the fortress line in northern Sinai and the posts on the Mediterranean coast. What was rewritten was the system of vassalage: the names of the city-states such as Carchemish, Emar and Tunip reappeared on the tribute copies, the names of the local princes were cut once more on the boundary stelae, and suzerainty was maintained by the repetition of ceremony rather than by a standing garrison. In the long run of the dynasty this war belongs to the last steps of drawing the northern policy inward: in the closing years of Thutmose III the attention of the court turned to Nubia, to the royal festivals and to the building works at Thebes, and large expeditions ceased to be the rule; his successor Amenhotep II still had to deal with trouble in Canaan, and by the time of Akhenaten the Eighteenth Dynasty had lost most of its hold on the Levant. For the northern powers these expeditions were a signal too: Mitanni and the Hittites had to reappraise their alliances, and that rivalry in the north is still visible in the correspondence of the Amarna period, while the Hittite texts later treat Egypt as the principal enemy — precisely on this Levantine front.
result: 打到最後，埃及並沒有佔領奧龍特斯河谷或幼發拉底河上游的城市，也沒有把聯軍吸收進版圖；結果是相關諸邦恢復進貢與服從，重新承認法老的宗主權，並按例交出歲貢與人質。遠征隊在初冬前撤出，隊伍回到三角洲，這一場在形式上完成，沒有留下可以長久駐紮的據點，只留下卡爾納克牆上一段進貢抄本與一紙界碑名單。從系列看，這是圖特摩斯三世十七次敘利亞遠征的第十五次，其後還有兩次，隨後王朝的北方政策便開始收縮，遠征的傳統要到第十九王朝才重新拾起，並最終在同一條奧龍特斯河與幼發拉底河的山谷裡，拉美西斯二世與赫梯聯軍爆發出比圖特摩斯三世時代更激烈也更有破壞力的戰役。可以確定的是，這一場之後北線維持了數十年安寧，直到帝國整體收縮時才被放棄。
resultEn: In the end Egypt occupied none of the cities of the Orontes valley or of the upper Euphrates, and took no part of the coalition into its map; what it obtained was the resumed tribute and obedience of the relevant city-states, a renewed acknowledgement of the pharaoh's suzerainty, and the customary payment of tribute and hostages. The column withdrew before the winter and returned to the Delta; the campaign was complete in form and left behind no post it could hold for long, only a copy of the tribute list on the walls of Karnak and a list of names on a boundary stela. Across the series this was the fifteenth of Thutmose III's seventeen Syrian campaigns; two more followed, and then the northern policy of the dynasty began to contract. The expeditionary tradition was not revived until the Nineteenth Dynasty, when it finally collided at Hatti in the same valleys of the Orontes and the Euphrates, in a war under Ramesses II that was far more violent and far more destructive than anything Thutmose III had fought. What can be said with certainty is that after this campaign the northern line held for several decades, and was given up only when the empire contracted as a whole.
